result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline – v2.8
qualifications: As publicly disclosed in Bug #1886467, there were 1,161 SSL certificates issued without id-kp-serverAuth attribute. Revocation was completed by June 2024. As a result, a criterion of 2.5 of Principle 2 WebTrust for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline v2.8 has not been met.

As publicly disclosed in Bug #1890123 regarding the mis-issued EV SSL certificates reported in Bugzilla 1883843 and 1890898, a preliminary incident report was not provided within the required 24-hour timeframe.

disclosed_matters.topic: Updates to CPS Versions Addressing EV SSL Certificate Issues and Client Authentication
disclosed_matters.summary: CPS V3.17 was updated on March 21, 2024, to correct mis-issued EV SSL certificates reported in Bugzilla 1883843, but did not completely address Client Authentication details disclosed in Bugzilla 1887753, requiring further update to CPS V3.1.8 on March 22, 2024.

disclosed_matters.topic: Updates to CPS Version Addressing typographical (text placement) error
disclosed_matters.summary: CPS V3.1.8 dated March 22, 2024, was updated to require policyQualifier for EV certificate profile per Bugzilla 1890896, but inadvertently added this requirement to the OV certificate profile where it was not required, which was corrected in CPS V3.20 on March 26, 2024.
